```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)
library(scales)

```



```{r}
data1 <- read_csv("Mass_Arrests (1).csv") 
names(data1) <- trimws(names(data1))
data1$Race <- as.factor(data1$Race) 
data1$Sex <- as.factor(data1$Sex) 
data_clean <- data1 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Race), !is.na(Sex)) 
data_clean$Sex <- recode(data_clean$Sex, "F" = "Female", "M" = "Male", "U" = "Unknown") 
data_clean$Race <- recode(data_clean$Race, "B" = "Black", "H" = "Hispanic", "W" = "White", "I" = "Indigenous", "J" = "Asian", "O" = "Other", "U" = "Unknown")
```


```{r}
covid <- read_csv("covid-19.csv")

covid$date <- as.Date(covid$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

covid <- covid %>%
  filter(!is.na(daily_cases_mean),
         !is.na(daily_deaths_mean))

covid_monthly <- covid %>%
  mutate(yearMonth = format(date, "%Y-%m-01")) %>%
  group_by(yearMonth) %>%
  summarise(
    cases = sum(daily_cases_mean),
    deaths = sum(daily_deaths_mean)
  )

covid_monthly$yearMonth <- as.Date(covid_monthly$yearMonth)
```

CAT-CAT RACE VS GENDER
```{r}
RaceSex_table <- table(data_clean$Race, data_clean$Sex) 
RaceSex_df <- as.data.frame(RaceSex_table) 
colnames(RaceSex_df) <- c("Race", "Sex", "count")

RaceSex_df <- RaceSex_df %>% 
group_by(Sex) %>% 
mutate(pct = count / sum(count)) 

RaceSex_df <- RaceSex_df %>%
  filter(Sex %in% c("Male", "Female"),
         Race != "Other")

ggplot(RaceSex_df,
       aes(x = Sex, y = pct, fill = Race)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Arrests by Race and Gender",
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Percent of Arrests",
    fill = "Race"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
NUM-NUM COVID CASES & DEATHS
```{r}
ggplot(covid_monthly, aes(x = cases, y = deaths)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between COVID-19 Cases and Deaths",
    x = "Total Cases",
    y = "Total Deaths"
  ) +
  theme_light()
```
NUM-CAT AGE & ARRESTS
```{r}
data2 <- read.csv("Mass_Arrests (1).csv")
names(data2) <- make.names(names(data2))

data2_clean <- data2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Arrest.Type),
         Arrest.Type != "",
         !is.na(Age))

data2_clean$Arrest.Type <- recode(data2_clean$Arrest.Type,
  "F" = "Felony",
  "M" = "Misdemeanor",
  "O" = "Other",
  "W" = "Warrant"
)

ggplot(data2_clean, aes(x = Arrest.Type, y = Age)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "red", trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution by Arrest Type",
    x = "Arrest Type",
    y = "Age"
  )
```


REWORKED GRAPHS

```{r}
safecities1 <- read_csv("safeCities.csv") %>%
  clean_names()
safe_clean <- safecities1 %>%
  select(
    city,
    overall_score,
    p_out_prevalence_of_crime,
    p_out_level_of_corruption,
    h_in_mental_health   # 👈 replaced here
  ) %>%
  drop_na()
```

```{r}
graph1 <- ggplot(safe_clean, aes(
  x = p_out_prevalence_of_crime,
  y = overall_score,
  color = p_out_level_of_corruption
)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Original: Crime vs Safety (Colored by Corruption)",
    x = "Crime Level",
    y = "Overall Safety Score",
    color = "Corruption"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
g_improved <- ggplot(safe_clean, aes(
  x = p_out_prevalence_of_crime,
  y = overall_score
)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.6, size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Improved: Crime vs Safety",
    x = "Crime Level",
    y = "Overall Safety Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

g_improved
